The Tamashii Nations Saint Seiya Myth Cloth Aries Mu Action Figure beautifully captures the legendary Aries Mu character from the Saint Seiya series. Produced by the respected Tamashii Nations brand, this figure features Aries Mu adorned in his iconic golden cloth, rendered with precise detail and vibrant coloration. Standing approximately 6.7 inches tall, it is an exceptional collectible for fans of the franchise and action figure enthusiasts alike.

This action figure offers articulated joints for dynamic posing and includes a unique feature that allows the golden Aries Mu cloth to be rearranged into an object form, enhancing display versatility. Accompanied by a cloth repair tool, it provides an interactive experience that maintains the figure's authenticity and charm. Released in 2007, this figure remains a prized piece within the Saint Seiya collectible community.

Care instructions

To maintain the quality of your Tamashii Nations Saint Seiya Myth Cloth Aries Mu Action Figure, gently dust it regularly using a soft, dry cloth. Avoid using water or harsh chemicals as the figure is made of polyvinyl chloride which can be damaged by moisture. Store the figure away from direct sunlight to prevent color fading and keep it in a dust-free environment or display case when not in use. Handle the figure carefully to avoid damage to its articulated parts and cloth components. Use the included cloth repair tool as instructed to maintain the cloth's condition.
